_what: Separate experiment (tools/rl_compare, A50-1, user 2026-10-27: test RL against the planner Nong uses now, with videos). Nothing in the hub or Studio reads this. data: where the private cheer v2 files are (dir) and the source videos (sourceDir), relative to the code folder; dances = the <name>_analysis.json sets to compare. out: where every result goes (git-ignored .local, kept for the user; experiments.jsonl there = every run's full record: config, commit, seeds, hardware, timings, raw scores). repoSummary: the tables only (no private data), rewritten after each full run so the numbers can be committed (user 2026-10-27: keep every experiment for a possible thesis). scenarios: the same rules for every contender; safeDps = the board's peak-speed cap (60 = today's firmware), null = only the servos' own limits; gapMm = closer than this counts as a collision for the planner (it plans with it), the RL episode and every score (user 2026-10-27: 5 mm, then asked about 10 mm for servo backlash on several joints), null = Studio's own gap (safe_path.json clearMm + rig extraClearanceMm). servo: how a servo follows the board's 50 Hz targets: first-order lag lagMs (a guess until measured; a rig servoLagMs list wins) and the rig's servoMaxDps. colors are BGR for the videos. planner: Studio's vidBuild run headless, once per variant; music false = slow down to keep the shape (how v2 was made), true = keep the music and cut moves short. rl: the imitation policy; controlHz = how often it decides, envs = parallel robots on the GPU, horizonS = training episode length (random start in the song), lookaheadS = how far ahead it sees the dancer, rounds x updatesPerRound = training length (one video clip per round), reward weights below. metrics: nearMm = where the RL reward starts pushing away from a touch; limitDeg = how close to a joint stop counts as hitting it. video: size, fps, camera angles (yaw/pitch deg), clip seconds per training round, and the budget the whole out folder must stay under.
